metadata.name: Code Pump Incident Understanding Challenge Set
metadata.description: Independently authored challenge set (no organizer records, no PII). Built to stress-test both the frozen deterministic baseline and the frozen learned classifier on Spanish and Portuguese.

tier_definitions.DIRECT: Explicit, unambiguous phrasing of the label.
tier_definitions.INDIRECT: Describes consequences rather than the label keyword.
tier_definitions.HARD_NEGATIVE: Mentions a competing class but the true label wins.
